title: Relative right Kan extensions: universal restriction and cone comparison
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functor categories, mapping spaces, full subcategories and cones of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], relative limit diagrams of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone], and isofibrations of [lem-coef-infinity-isofibration-exponentiation]. Work in any fixed sufficiently large universe. Let $A\subseteq C$ be a full subcategory of a small quasicategory, let $p:D\to B$ be an isofibration of quasicategories, and let $s:C\to B$ be a fixed functor. Write $\operatorname{Fun}_s(C,D)$ for the simplicial set of functors over $s$: an $r$-simplex is $H:C\times\Delta^r\to D$ with $pH=s\operatorname{pr}_C$.

For $c\in C$ put $L_c=A\times_C C_{c/}$, with projection $a_c:L_c\to A$ and canonical cone $l_c:L_c^{\triangleleft}\to C$. The coslice records arrows starting at $c$, with all commuting simplices, and projects by their final face. Say that $H\in\operatorname{Fun}_s(C,D)$ is a pointwise $p$-right Kan extension of $H|_A$ if $Hl_c$ is a $p$-limit diagram for every $c$. Let $R\subseteq\operatorname{Fun}_s(C,D)$ be the full subcategory of such extensions, and let $T\subseteq\operatorname{Fun}_{s|_A}(A,D)$ be the full subcategory of functors $h$ for which, for every $c$, $ha_c$ admits a $p$-limit cone over the specified base cone $sl_c$, with exactly the prescribed boundary $ha_c$. Then restriction $R\to T$ is a trivial Kan fibration of simplicial sets, in particular an equivalence of full infinity categories. Here a trivial Kan fibration means a map with the right lifting property against every boundary inclusion $\partial\Delta^r\hookrightarrow\Delta^r$, $r\geq0$; the boundary is the union of proper faces of the standard simplex. The assertion is about all transformations and higher simplices, not only objects.

There is also a cone comparison. If $H:C\to D$ is a pointwise $p$-right Kan extension of $H|_A$, $b:C^{\triangleleft}\to B$ extends $pH$, and $q_A:A^{\triangleleft}\to D$ restricts to $H|_A$ and satisfies $pq_A=b|_{A^{\triangleleft}}$, then $q_A$ extends to $q:C^{\triangleleft}\to D$ with $q|_C=H$, $q|_{A^{\triangleleft}}=q_A$ and $pq=b$, whenever $q_A$ is a $p$-limit diagram. Any such $q$ is a $p$-limit diagram if and only if $q_A$ is. Thus existence and the universal property of a relative limit of a right Kan extended diagram can be checked on the full subcategory from which it was extended. Neither $D$ nor its fibers are assumed complete.
